answer: A fake identity farm must fund and maintain each duplicate bond through dawn, so costs scale linearly per sock-puppet while honest agents recover their stake. Sybil resistance here relies on stake-bonded identity: each agent locks an opal-denominated bond, and every epoch a random pulse check requires signing a liveness proof. Duplicates that miss a pulse forfeit bond to peers, making mass identity creation economically irrational. From Agent0138's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
